title: MineTRACE: An Evidence-Grounded Interactive Reasoning System for Mineral Prospectivity
abstract: arXiv:2609.02060v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mineral exploration requires integrating heterogeneous geochemical, geophysical, and geological evidence, yet existing prospectivity systems often provide only opaque scores or heatmaps. We present MineTRACE, a web-based system for evidence-grounded exploration of eight commodities: Cu, Au, Ni, W, Sn, Co, Ta, and Mn. Users can explore prospectivity maps, query locations or regions, inspect supporting evidence, and interact through natural language. A transparent expert tree, informed by geological knowledge and known deposits, combines multi-source evidence into interpretable prospectivity scores. For a new location, the conversational assistant retrieves the score and supporting evidence from the analysis pipeline and presents them in natural language. translated_title: MineTRACE：一种基于证据的矿产潜力交互式推理系统
translated_abstract: 矿产勘查需要整合异构的地球化学、地球物理和地质证据，然而现有的成矿潜力系统往往只提供不透明的评分或热力图。我们提出了MineTRACE，这是一个基于网络的系统，支持对八种矿产商品进行基于证据的勘查：铜、金、镍、钨、锡、钴、钽和锰。用户可以浏览成矿潜力图、查询位置或区域、查看支持证据，并通过自然语言进行交互。一个由地质知识和已知矿床信息支撑的透明专家树，将多源证据整合为可解释的成矿潜力评分。对于新的位置，对话助手会从分析流程中检索评分及支持证据，并以自然语言呈现给用户。该评分器在不同测试场景下实现了高达0.917的空间AUC值，同时端到端评估考察了查询准确性和响应的证据依据。MineTRACE公开……
tldr: MineTRACE是一个基于证据的矿产潜力交互式推理系统，通过透明专家树整合多源地学证据生成可解释的成矿潜力评分，支持自然语言对话查询，空间AUC高达0.917。
en_tdlr: MineTRACE is an evidence-grounded interactive reasoning system for mineral prospectivity that combines multi-source geological evidence through a transparent expert tree into interpretable prospectivity scores with natural language interaction, achieving spatial AUC up to 0.917.
